violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED PRIOR TO END OF INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: meatball and marinara 100°F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. REHEATED TO 161°F

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: shelves in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM AVAILABLE AT THIS FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED NO HANDWASHING SIGN AT HANDWASHING SINK IN SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: OBSERVED HOLE AT BOTTOM RIGHT OF BACK DOOR LEADING TO THE OUTSIDE.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED FOOD IN BOXES ON FLOOR OF WALK-IN COOLER AND WALK-IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the HANDWASHING SINK NEAR MOP SINK is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Subway (Inspection Date: 07/23/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK NEAR MOP SINK TO BE SPRAYING IN THREE DIFFERENT DIRECTIONS, ONE OF WHICH POURS OVER THE SIDE OF THE SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.
